title: Facebook page leads to Michael Johnson

tellings.quote: a fan of the show, shout out Jason Miller, hit us up with a Facebook page, a page just sitting there, and lo and behold, it was for a 70some yearear-old Michael Johnson living in South Carolina

plain: In 2026 a fan of the show named Jason Miller sent the team a Facebook page that led them to Michael Johnson, a man in his seventies living in South Carolina. Michels tells this in an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens and who reunite 50 years later, as the way the show tracked Johnson down.
